name: Guling Street Avant-garde Theatre
scope: The historic corner theatre and former Zhongzheng Second Precinct police station at No. 2, Lane 5, Guling Street, with its angled recessed entrance, Art Deco balcony, and the connected three-storey rear wing.
era: Standing restored theatre in a former police station.

originalReview.notes: Byte-identical native Qualla and Commons creator-released photograph. The original English Wikipedia upload log names Peter Bronski as photographer, and the first Commons transfer retains the explicit creator release. Seat of the projecting balcony, divided casements and ribbed angled corner seen clearly.
